ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all beneficial owners, General Partner signatories and authorized representatives against: (i) the Bermuda Proscribed Persons list and Financial Intelligence Agency (FIA) advisories; (ii) UN Security Council consolidated lists pursuant to Resolutions 1267, 1988 and 1373; (iii) the UK Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation (OFSI) consolidated list, extended to Bermuda by Order in Council; (iv) OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Consolidated Sanctions lists, given Bermuda banks' and payment processors' US correspondent relationships; and (v) the EU consolidated sanctions lists. Screening must be performed by automated database (World-Check/Dow Jones Risk & Compliance or equivalent) within 48 hours of receipt of KYC documentation, with enhanced due diligence under FATF Recommendation 12 and Regulations 10-12 of the Proceeds of Crime (Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Terrorist Financing) Regulations 2018 upon any PEP match, adverse media flag or sanctions hit; all results must be documented and retained by the registered agent for at least five years post-termination of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Bermuda Registraria de Companhias (Department of Registry General, Registrar of Companies; name clearance is filed electronically via the e-Government portal at www.gov.bm or through the licensed registered agent's e-filing interface)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names must be rendered in the Latin/English alphabet; no Cyrillic, Arabic or other script transliteration is recognized in the official register. The name must end with the words 'Limited Partnership' or the abbreviation 'L.P.' or 'LP' and must not be identical or confusingly similar to any name already registered in Bermuda, including exempted companies, overseas companies, limited partnerships and other legal persons.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank, Banking, Trust, Insurance, Assurance, Reinsurance, Fund (require a license from or prior consent of the Bermuda Monetary Authority)
Royal, Imperial, Crown, Government, Ministry, Municipal, Authority, Bermuda (imply government affiliation and require ministerial approval)
Chartered, College, University, Institute, Association, Chamber of Commerce (require approval of the relevant professional body)

Gaming, Gambling, Casino, Lottery, Luck, Play-to-Earn (trigger review under the Gambling Act 2020; require legal confirmation that polyhedral RPG dice are manufactured gaming accessories and not gaming machines or lottery devices)
Offshore, International, Global (where the name implies a regulated cross-border financial services activity not authorized for the ELP)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant via the registered agent may file a written request for reconsideration with the Registrar of Companies within 14 days of the notice of rejection, stating the grounds of distinctiveness and attaching a formal register search report. If the Registrar affirms the refusal, an appeal lies to the Minister of Finance, who must determine the appeal within 30 days, with a copy to the Director of the Department of Registry General. The Registrar's decision remains subject to judicial review by the Supreme Court of Bermuda. A reserved name may be extended for an additional 30 days by written application and payment of the statutory extension fee, provided the registration of the ELP is actively in progress.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Statutory virtual office NOT PERMITTED for the registered office. Section 7 of the Exempted Limited Partnerships Act 2015 requires a physical registered office in Bermuda at all times, being the address of the licensed registered agent, where process may be served and documents kept. The commercial operations of the partnership (handmade epoxy resin dice casting, crowdfunding and online retail) may lawfully be conducted entirely outside Bermuda; however, the ELP must file the annual ELP return and an Economic Substance declaration confirming that it does not carry on a 'relevant activity' for Bermuda economic substance purposes.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low: estimated <5% probability of an unannounced physical on-site inspection of the ELP's registered office by the Registrar of Companies or the Bermuda Monetary Authority during the first 12 months for a low-risk standard consumer goods business; however, the registered agent's office is subject to routine BMA and Registrar inspections, and any change of registered office must be filed within 14 days together with a Validation Report when the agent is changed.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Exempted Limited Partnerships Act 1883 (Bermuda), as amended — ss. 2-9 (constitution of limited partnerships, execution and registration of the Section 5 Statement, certificate of registration); Limited Partnerships Act 1883 (default rules); Business Licences Act 1987 s. 3 (operational licence); Economic Substance Act 2018 (annual declaration)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Companies, Companies Registry, Department of the Registrar of Companies, Government of Bermuda — 55 Court Street, Hamilton HM 12, Bermuda
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Statement under Section 5(1) of the Exempted Limited Partnerships Act 1883 — Application for Registration of an Exempted Limited Partnership
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow account requirement; the Limited Partnership Agreement must record each limited partner's capital contribution, and the general partner must evidence the source of funds to the partnership's licensed banker under the Bermuda AML/ATF Rules
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST RESOLUTION OF THE GENERAL PARTNER OF [NAME] EXEMPTED LIMITED PARTNERSHIP (adopted in lieu of a board meeting under the Exempted Limited Partnerships Act 1883). RESOLVED: (1) that the Section 5 Statement be approved and the authorised signatory be directed to execute, notarise, and file it with the Registrar of Companies; (2) that the registered office be established with the licensed corporate service provider in Hamilton, Bermuda; (3) that [NAME] be appointed general partner and [NAME] principal officer and AML compliance officer; (4) that the limited partners' initial capital contributions be deposited with the partnership's licensed banker under the Limited Partnership Agreement; and (5) that all Government of Bermuda registration, business licence, and annual fees be paid when due.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Pre-Approval for Exempted Status
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Companies Registry, Government of Bermuda (eServices portal or in person at 55 Court Street, Hamilton)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed ELP name for reservation through the Bermuda Registry eServices portal. The name must end with 'Limited Partnership' or 'L.P.' and must not be identical or deceptively similar to a name already on the Register. State the ELP's object (manufacture and distribution of tabletop gaming accessories) and the declaration of intent to register as an exempted limited partnership. Provide identification of the general partner and the registered office service provider. The Registrar returns a name-approval notice within the service standard.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation of the general partner, if corporate
Identity documents of the proposed general and limited partners
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or queried, submit up to two alternative names within 10 working days or address the Registrar by formal written consent request; the name reservation fee may be credited toward the final registration fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarial Execution of the LP Agreement and Section 5 Statement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Bermuda corporate service provider and Bermuda counsel / public notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the licensed CSP to draft the Limited Partnership Agreement and the Statement under Section 5(1) of the ELPA 1883 containing the proposed name, Bermuda registered office, full identity of the general partner, aggregate capital contributions of the limited partners, and the object clause. The Statement must be signed by each general and limited partner (or authorised attorney-in-fact), witnessed by two persons, and notarized. Obtain the signed acceptance letter of the Bermuda registered office service provider. Record the contribution schedule; no minimum capital is due.
required_dossiers: Passport or national ID of each general and limited partner
Certificate of Incorporation and board resolution of a corporate general partner, if applicable
Registered office service provider acceptance letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where drafting or notarization is defective, the CSP re-issues the corrected Statement and the partners re-execute it without additional registry fees if re-filed within 14 days of the initial query.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Filing, Fee Payment and Certificate of Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Companies Registry, Government of Bermuda
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed Section 5 Statement with the Registrar via the eServices portal or in person, pay the Bermuda Government registration fee of US$1,780, and submit the registered office acceptance letter. The Registrar examines the Statement for statutory completeness and, upon satisfaction, issues the Certificate of Registration and enters the ELP on the Register of Exempted Limited Partnerships. Preserve the Certificate as the foundational record for the subsequent banking and EMI onboarding phase.
required_dossiers: Consent of the general partner to act
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a requisition under Section 6(2) of the ELPA, deliver a corrective written response within 21 days; non-response is cured by re-filing a fresh Statement with the prescribed fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Statutory Records, Tax Exemption and Economic Substance Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies; Ministry of Finance, Tax Assurance Unit, Government of Bermuda
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Maintain the registers of general and limited partners at the Bermuda registered office. Apply for the Bermuda exempted-partnership tax certificate (exemption from Bermuda income tax) and file the annual economic substance declaration under the Economic Substance Act 2018. Confirm whether the ELP qualifies for the 'excluded entity' conditions or otherwise satisfies substance requirements, and file the annual declaration of good standing with the Registrar.
required_dossiers: Register of general partners and register of limited partners
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: For late economic substance or annual filings, submit a late-filing relief application with the applicable administrative penalty; reinstatement follows the Registrar's confirmation of good standing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Industrial, Environmental and Fire-Safety Licensing for the Resin Casting Facility
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Licence Unit, Ministry of Economic Development; Department of Environment and Natural Resources; Bermuda Fire and Rescue Service
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: If the dice casting activity is physically carried on in Bermuda, obtain in sequence: (i) a fire safety certificate from the Bermuda Fire and Rescue Service under the Fire Safety in Buildings Act 2008; (ii) environmental registration at Category 2 level (Statement of Environmental Commitment) from the Department of Environment and Natural Resources covering epoxy resin VOC emissions, resin waste and wash-water disposal; and (iii) a Bermuda Business Licence under the Business Licences Act 1987 for the manufacture of games and toys. If the ELP carries on business wholly outside Bermuda, file the annual exemption declaration with the Registrar and rely on an outsourced contract-manufacturing model.
required_dossiers: Environmental registration and Statement of Environmental Commitment form
Lease or title to the manufacturing premises
Certificate of Registration of the ELP
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: DENR queries are cured by submitting an emissions-control and waste-management remediation plan within 60 days; a refused Business Licence may be appealed to the Minister of Economic Development within 30 days of the refusal notice.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Business Licence Unit, Ministry of Economic Development, Government of Bermuda
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Bermuda Business Licence (Business Licences Act 1987) — Manufacturing of Games and Toys; no gaming or gambling licence is required for tabletop polyhedral dice; an annual exemption declaration is filed where the ELP transacts exclusively outside Bermuda

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR), Government of Bermuda
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 2 — Registration with a Statement of Environmental Commitment (SEC) required for small-scale epoxy resin casting under the Environmental Impact Assessment Regulations 2018; a full EIA Report is not required for this scale of operation
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: VOC air emissions must comply with the ambient thresholds of the Clean Air Act 1993; no uncured resin may enter the wastewater system under the Water Resources (Waste Disposal) Regulations 1994; epoxy resin and sharp-edge casting waste must be removed by a licensed waste contractor under the Waste Management Regulations 2018

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Bermuda Fire and Rescue Service under the Fire Safety in Buildings Act 2008; structural load inspection from the Building Safety Section under the Building Act 1986; workplace clearance for epoxy handling and sharp-edge casting under the Occupational Health and Safety Act 1982

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Office of the Tax Commissioner (OTC), Ministry of Finance, Bermuda Government, portal: taxcommissioner.gov.bm; Bermuda Customs Department (ASYCUDA World electronic single window), portal: customs.gov.bm; Registrar of Companies, Ministry of Finance (ELP formation and annual declarations), portal: roc.gov.bm. Bermuda is a fiscally autonomous British Overseas Territory; no UK HMRC registration arises unless the ELP creates a UK taxable presence, sells into the UK above distance-selling thresholds, or engages UK-resident employees.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1) Register the Exempted Limited Partnership (ELP) under the Exempted Partnerships Act 2009 by filing the partnership application, limited partnership statements, and registered-office consent with the Registrar of Companies; obtain the Certificate of Limited Partnership; the Bermuda Registration Number is the sole statutory identifier because no income-tax TIN is issued in a jurisdiction without corporate/income tax. 2) Submit a non-resident designation application under the Exchange Control Act 1972 through the Registrar or an authorised bank, releasing the ELP from exchange-control restrictions on foreign-currency accounts. 3) Register as importer/exporter with the Bermuda Customs Department through a licensed customs broker and obtain an ASYCUDA World customs code before any physical movement of dice, resin, or packaging materials. 4) File the annual Economic Substance Act 2018 declaration confirming that the ELP performs no relevant activity in Bermuda and is a tax resident of a foreign jurisdiction (or otherwise excluded). 5) If the ELP later employs Bermuda-resident staff, register for payroll tax with the OTC within 15 days of the first emolument payment.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Pass_Through_Eligible; Territorial_Scope: profits are not taxable at the ELP level in Bermuda; partners are taxable only in their own jurisdictions of residence. Tax_Exempt_Zone: the ELP enjoys statutory assurance against future Bermudian taxes introduced after formation, subject to the Corporate Tax Act 2023 (15% Domestic Minimum Top-up Tax) which applies solely to multinational enterprise groups with consolidated revenue of at least EUR 750 million and is inapplicable to this tabletop-gaming dice SME.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: US check-the-box election under Treas. Reg. § 301.7701-3 (Form 8832) to classify the ELP as a partnership (default) or association (corporation) for US federal tax purposes; UK tax transparency follows the entity's partnership law absent a UK permanent establishment; Exchange Control Act 1972 non-resident designation election; Economic Substance Act 2018 excepted-entity declaration; hybrid-mismatch analysis under IRC § 894 and UK TIOPA 2010 Part 6TA is required for UK/US partners because the ELP is fiscally transparent and no Bermudian entity-level tax exists.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Bermuda Customs Duty on Imports (there is no VAT, GST, or sales tax in Bermuda); Foreign Currency Purchase Tax (FCPT) at the standard rate of 4% applies to the purchase of foreign currency for settling import payables unless an exemption is granted; payroll tax applies only to Bermuda-resident employee compensation.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: N/A: no VAT/GST registration threshold exists. Customs registration (ASYCUDA World importer code) is mandatory for every import without regard to turnover. Payroll-tax registration applies upon engagement of the first Bermuda-resident employee. FCPT is administered at the bank/authorized-dealer level rather than through a statutory registration of the ELP.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Bermuda Customs operates the ASYCUDA World electronic single window, requiring real-time electronic cargo declarations, duty computation, risk-based selectivity, and clearance through integrated broker-led filing. There is no statutory e-invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, or digital stamping mandate for commercial sales invoices because no VAT/GST administration exists; export entries are filed electronically and exit dutiable scope without levy.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable as an input-credit zero-rating mechanism because Bermuda imposes no VAT/GST; exports from Bermuda are outside the scope of Bermuda customs duty and generate no Bermudian tax liability or refund claim. To secure this treatment for cast resin dice, the ELP must (i) physically export through the ASYCUDA World export-entry process, (ii) retain shipping and delivery evidence proving arrival in the destination economy, and (iii) route all sales proceeds into the ELP's designated foreign-currency account. If selling into the UK, UK import VAT and UK VAT registration become mandatory once distance sales of consignments not exceeding GBP 135 exceed GBP 10,000 per year, or if the ELP holds inventory in the UK.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Bermuda Customs, ASYCUDA World export entry)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
Inward Remittance Certificate (bank SWIFT credit advice evidencing export proceeds)
Commercial Invoice (HS 9504.90 classification, Incoterms, unit value, and quantity)
Certificate of Origin (issued on request for preferential tariff treatment)
Resin Safety Data Sheet and UN GHS transport classification (where applicable)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Bermuda Customs may conduct post-clearance audits within a three-year review window; false declarations or misdescription of exports attract forfeiture of goods, fines of up to BMD 25,000, and evasion penalties of up to treble the duty payable under the Customs Act 1971. Because the ELP pays no Bermuda profit tax, there is no fiscal clawback of export tax benefits. If the ELP instead claims UK VAT zero-rating as a deemed exporter, insufficient evidence can trigger HMRC assessments, penalties up to 100% of the VAT under Schedule 24 Finance Act 2007, interest, and criminal prosecution under section 72 VATA 1994 for fraudulent claims; records must be retained for at least six years. The 180-day repatriation parameter reflects a banking/EMI compliance convention aligned with Kickstarter/Stripe/PayPal payout reconciliation, not a Bermuda statutory deadline, because non-resident ELPs are exempt from exchange-control repatriation requirements.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Bermuda Monetary Authority (BMA) — issuing authority for the Bermuda dollar and principal financial regulator under the Currency Act 1972 and the Banks and Deposit Companies Act 1999
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Bermuda dollar (BMD) is pegged to the US dollar at 1:1 and is fully convertible for both current account and capital account transactions. There is no statutory exchange control regime, no central bank approval for profit remittance, and no required local reinvestment. Dividends, partnership distributions and capital repatriations from an Exempted Limited Partnership may be remitted freely to any non-resident partner, subject only to standard AML/KYC verification and compliance with Bermuda's economic substance filing expectations. The absence of capital controls makes Bermuda an efficient jurisdiction for cross-border treasury operations of a low-risk tabletop gaming accessories business.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Bermuda imposes no surrender obligations, no mandatory conversion ratios, and no statutory timeline for export proceeds. All export receivables, including payments received through crowdfunding platforms, payment gateways and commercial trade settlements, may be retained in any convertible currency without requiring repatriation or central bank approval. The only applicable discipline is corporate record-keeping and accurate financial reporting consistent with the partnership agreement and Bermuda tax monitoring requirements.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Moderately viable. Foreign unlicensed digital EMIs such as Wise, Airwallex or Revolut may be used as technical payment initiators and settlement processors for non-deposit-taking treasury flows, but they are not permitted to operate as deposit-taking institutions in Bermuda without a BMA licence under the Banks and Deposit Companies Act 1999. For the target business, using a licensed Bermuda commercial bank as the primary treasury anchor while layering a foreign EMI for low-value Kickstarter/Stripe/PayPal settlement proceeds is defensible, provided the EMI holds a valid license in its home jurisdiction, maintains segregated client accounts, and does not market deposit facilities in Bermuda.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote account opening is generally permitted for a Bermuda Exempted Limited Partnership through its registered agent and licensed corporate service provider. The BMA's AML/ATF framework allows reliance on the CSP's client due diligence, but a bank may require at least one authorised partner, director or beneficial owner to attend a video interview; physical presence is not an absolute statutory mandate but may be requested by the bank's compliance team for higher-risk structures. The practical standard is: certified partnership and constitutional documents, notarised identification of all beneficial owners, and a CSP covering letter confirming due diligence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore pass-through entity with no employees or physical office
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of the Certificate of Limited Partnership, registered partnership agreement, list of general and limited partners, audited or management financial statements, proof of economic substance registration if applicable, and a written business plan showing physical supply chain operations using third-party fulfilment providers.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital contributions from multiple non-resident partners via overseas wires
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Source-of-funds declarations for each partner, personal or corporate bank statements, notarised investor identification, sworn certification of lawful origin of funds, and a schedule reconciling all inbound capital injections to the partnership's capital accounts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume crowdfunding and marketplace receipts from retail counterparties through Stripe and PayPal
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Platform payout reports showing transaction history, merchant settlement statements, customer invoices or order records, the underlying crowdfunding campaign terms, fraud-control confirmations from the payment processors, and a cash-flow reconciliation report demonstrating that payouts directly correspond to commercial sales of handmade dice products.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections should be routed via SWIFT MT103 (or MT202 for correspondent tiering) to the ELP's Bermuda bank account. The payment narrative must state 'Capital Contribution to Exempted Limited Partnership' and reference the registered partnership agreement and relevant capital schedule. The receiving bank will require the ELP certificate, identity of all partners, and a source-of-funds questionnaire. BMD/USD accounts use a US correspondent bank; no IBAN is required. For crowdfunding proceeds, Stripe and PayPal are permitted as upstream aggregators, followed by periodic settlement sweeps to the Bermuda treasury account using standard payout rails with automatic reconciliation.

stage_4.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade settlements for raw materials, dyes, moulds, packaging and fulfilment services should be executed via SWIFT MT103 open-account transfers for amounts below bank threshold limits. For larger recurring or letter-of-credit-based procurements, a Commercial Letter of Credit issued through the Bermuda bank's trade finance desk is permissible. Partner profit distributions should be remitted via SWIFT MT103 to the partner's personal or corporate bank account with narrative 'ELP Profit Distribution' and a supporting distribution resolution. All outbound payments remain fully liberalised with no exchange control approval, subject only to sanctions screening and AML transaction monitoring.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) for currencies subject to convertibility restrictions where the BMD/USD peg renders deliverable forwards inefficient
Plain-vanilla Currency Swaps for cross-currency balance-sheet management
Cross-Currency Interest Rate Swaps for multi-currency borrowing or investment positions
FX Options (European-style) to hedge crowdfunding and marketplace receivables against adverse GBP/EUR/USD movements

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return / Annual Solvency and Status Declaration for Exempted Limited Partnership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies, Bermuda (Ministry of Finance)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 60 days after the annual anniversary of the ELP's registration date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late fee of BMD 300 per month or partial month after the due date; continued default for 12 months may result in administrative warning, BMD 1,000 reinstatement fee, and strike-off from the Bermuda Register of Exempted Limited Partnerships.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Economic Substance Return (declaration of relevant activity or nil return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Bermuda Registrar of Companies / Economic Substance Department
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after the end of the ELP's financial year; for a calendar-year financial period, due by 30 June of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Default penalty of BMD 10,000 plus BMD 10,000 per additional month of non-compliance, subject to maximum BMD 100,000; information may be exchanged with UK and other competent authorities.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership Register Update and Trigger Filing (in-scope ELP only)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Bermuda Financial Intelligence Agency / Beneficial Ownership Portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No fixed annual filing date; update required within 14 days after any change in beneficial ownership, transfer of partnership interest, or change of general partner
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty up to BMD 5,000 per offence and BMD 10,000 for continuing default; serious non-compliance may result in restrictions on partnership distributions and administrative strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Bermuda imposes no statutory audit threshold on a non-regulated exempted limited partnership. A mandatory independent audit arises only if the ELP is licensed under Bermuda financial services legislation (e.g., insurance, banking, investment business), if the partnership agreement or an investor side letter requires audited accounts, or if UK group/company law requires an audit because the UK trade or parent group exceeds the applicable UK exemption thresholds.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Bermuda has no prescribed general-purpose local GAAP for exempted limited partnerships. Financial statements, when required, should be prepared under UK-adopted IFRS or UK GAAP (FRS 102) as appropriate for the UK parent or UK permanent establishment; Bermuda-regulated ELPs, if any, are expected to follow IFRS.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Bermuda does not require a standalone annual UBO confirmation statement equivalent to the UK PSC regime. The general partner must, however, perform an annual internal review of the private Register of Beneficial Owners and ensure the Annual Return certifies that the register is accurate. Any transfer of a partnership interest or change in beneficial ownership must be updated in the Bermuda Beneficial Ownership Portal within 14 days after the event; no separate calendar-year filing is required.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of General Partner and Bermuda Resident Agent
Register of Charges or Encumbrances over Partnership Assets
Minute Book of General Partner Resolutions and Consent Records

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$2,000 to US$3,500 per annum for a licensed Bermuda registered office, resident agent, corporate secretarial support, and annual return preparation
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: No Bermuda statutory audit is required for this ELP; if a voluntary or UK group-requested audit is prepared, a representative range is US$12,000 to US$25,000 per annum depending on transaction volume and partner count

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% - Bermuda imposes no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, no VAT and no withholding tax. The Exempted Limited Partnership (ELP) is a transparent pass-through entity; profits are taxable only in the hands of the partners. A UK-resident corporate partner is subject to UK corporation tax at up to 25% on its distributive share of the ELP's trading or property income.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Nil effective Bermuda tax rate. A Tax Protection Certificate may be obtained under the Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966, guaranteeing exemption from Bermuda income, capital, and dividend taxes for the protected period (commonly to 31 March 2035 or 2050). No Bermuda payroll tax on the ELP unless it employs staff within Bermuda; no stamp duty on the issue of partnership interests; no property or land tax on off-shore business assets.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: CIT Return: None (Bermuda levies no corporate income tax on the ELP). Annual Administrative Filing: ELP Annual Return / Government Fee Return (Registrar of Companies, Exempted Limited Partnership Act 2015), filed electronically through the Bermuda Online Registry (e-Registry) maintained by the Registrar of Companies.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (anniversary-based calendar; die-cut fiscal year commonly aligned to 31 December).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 30 days of the anniversary of the ELP's registration (or the gazetted common compliance date of 30 June where the anniversary falls in the first half of the year). The annual Government fee must be tendered with the return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Bermuda Registrar of Companies - ELP Registration Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the Registrar-issued ELP number (format ELP-XXXXXX). A non-resident ELP is not issued a Bermudian Tax Identification Number; the Registrar reference serves as the unique identifier for all filings.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exempted undertaking legal name and registered office in Bermuda
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_guidance: State the exact registered name and the full address of the Bermuda registered office. A physical registered office is mandatory; a virtual mailbox or UK trading address is not acceptable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered office must be an active, non-resident agent or lawyer's office in Hamilton. The UK parent may not act as its own registered office.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: General partner and Bermuda resident representative
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_guidance: State the name and address of the general partner (typically a private limited company in the UK or Bermuda) and the appointed Bermuda-resident individual or licensed corporate service provider acting as representative.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident individual may act as general partner, but a Bermuda-resident representative must be retained to accept service of process and to file the annual return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_guidance: Select ISIC 3240 - Manufacture of games and toys. Describe the actual trade as 'Handmade sharp-edge epoxy resin liquid-core polyhedral RPG dice; online retail and global crowdfunding distribution.'
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the ELP only invoices sales and holds funds but performs no activity in Bermuda, still record the true ISIC activity; the Bernuda Economic Substance Return (below) will determine whether substance is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_guidance: Declare the aggregate capital commitments of partners. Bermuda law allows zero minimum capital; declare the actual contributions in USD or BMD. No Bermuda stamp duty is levied on the capital of an exempted limited partnership.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident partners may contribute in any freely convertible currency. The declaration is made by the general partner, and no bank guarantee is required.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing or non-payment of the annual Government fee triggers an automatic late penalty of BMD 200 per month up to a maximum of BMD 500; continued default for more than 90 days entitles the Registrar to strike the ELP off the register without a court order. A struck-off ELP is dissolved; any partner who transacts business in its name thereafter is jointly and severally liable for all obligations incurred. Re-instatement in the Register costs a statutory restoration fee and a court application fee if the strike-off has been gazetted.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Bermuda Economic Substance Return (ESR Return) - annual e-filing through the Bermuda ESR online portal operated by the Registrar of Companies under the Economic Substance Regulations 2018 (as amended). No CIT computation is included in this form; it is a substance/declaration return, not a tax computation.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual, for each financial period in which the ELP is a 'relevant entity' carrying on a 'relevant activity'.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within six months after the end of the ELP's financial period (e.g., a 31 December year-end requires the ESR return to be filed by 30 June of the following year).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_guidance: Tick the category that factually describes the ELP: 'Distribution and service centre' where the ELP purchases polyhedral dice from an affiliate and resells to independent third-party consumers via online platforms; 'Intellectual property business' if the ELP holds licensing or trademark rights; 'Pure equity holding entity' if the ELP holds only shares in a wholly-owned subsidiary and has no other income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: An ELP with no staff in Bermuda and no decision-making in Bermuda should not tick 'Pure equity holding' unless that is the sole factual activity; choosing the wrong box attracts a false-declaration penalty and an automatic referral to the UK tax authority.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income attributable to the relevant activity during the financial period
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_guidance: State gross receipts (in BMD/USD) from the activity before expenses, including crowdfunding proceeds, direct sales, and royalties. If gross income is below BMD 1,000,000, a reduced notification may be accepted; above that threshold, full substance evidence is expected.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report the ELP's total gross income on a glance-around basis, regardless of where the payers reside, and do not net out Stripe or Kickstarter fees.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_guidance: Describe where decisions to manage, take and dispose of major risks relating to goods are made; where the procurement of raw materials and the online distribution strategy are controlled; and whether any actual production of dice occurs in Bermuda.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Where all CIGA are performed in the UK by the parent's staff, the ELP must state the country where the work is physically performed and will automatically fail the Bermuda substance test.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Average number of qualified full-time employees in Bermuda
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_guidance: Insert the average headcount of employees of the general partner acting for the ELP in Bermuda, including staff performing purchasing, supply-chain, order-management and finance functions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident ELP with no Bermuda staff must record '0'. This will demonstrate failure of the substance test unless the entity is a pure equity holding entity or is exempt as resident in another jurisdiction (which is normally impossible for a transparent partnership).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical premises and annual operating expenditure in Bermuda
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_guidance: Report annual expenditure on the Bermuda office, equipment, information technology, and employee costs. The test is 'adequate to generate the income' considering all income from the relevant activity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the registered office is a mere service-provider address with no dedicated working space, report zero operating expenditure; the ESR return will be flagged as non-compliant in the review queue.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to meet the economic substance test: initial civil penalty of BMD 84,000 in respect of that financial period, with an additional penalty of BMD 84,000 for each consecutive non-compliant period following a compliance direction. Failure to file the return or incorrect information: up to BMD 250,000, together with automatic exchange of information with the UK under the UK-Bermuda Tax Information Exchange Agreement 2007 and publication of the default on the Registrar's website.
